summary: Westport Fuel Systems filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results. The release highlights 125% revenue growth at Cespira, its Volvo joint venture, a new development agreement for hydrogen HPDI technology, and a completed private placement raising approximately US$10 million with potential additional US$10 million from warrants. These are routine operational and financing updates, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other event triggering special-situation classification is present. The filing is a standard earnings report for a foreign private issuer.
